name: team-task-manager-full-stack
description: Production-ready MERN team task manager with JWT auth, RBAC, project management, task tracking, dashboard analytics, and Railway deployment support.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
